summary:
Screening estimate only, not an eligibility decision. Household: 7 people, married couple, one child under 18, Texas, no seniors, no disabilities, no pregnancy or infant, household earns $423,800/year from work, no Social Security, rent $200/month, employer health insurance, assets about $160,000-$200,000, other income unknown.

Worth checking (apply through the official programme to find out):
- Earned income tax credit (EITC): about $2,270-$2,400 a year, estimated 35% chance of eligibility.
- ACA premium tax credit: about $9,270-$11,380 a year, estimated 28% chance of eligibility.

Could not be determined from these answers (apply or ask 211 to check): Child tax credit (refundable part), Medicaid.

Not recommended from the answers given: SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, CHIP, free or reduced-price school meals.

Hand off to a caseworker: the remaining uncertainty would still cost about $2,602 a year in mistakes. Open questions include other income amount and whether the child tax credit and Medicaid apply. Immigration status was not asked and can change eligibility.
